scope: simulation_only; no real EEG or trained foundation model

target_definitions.spatial_patch_contrast: radial source dipoles in Gaussian left/right patches at x=+/-0.045 m, z=0.035 m; width=0.025 m; signed difference normalized to unit L2; constant waveform
target_definitions.temporal_waveform_difference: positive Gaussian source patch at x=0.035 m, y=0 m, z=0.035 m; width=0.025 m; unit L2; DCT-II temporal component index 2

covariance_scope: known, label-independent, fixed across heads within each montage/regime; nominal sensor coordinates define spatial covariance
mi_numerical_interval: estimate plus/minus 1.96 Monte Carlo SE; simulation integration uncertainty only

decoder_features.basis_scope: nominal physics/noise only; fixed before head draws; standardization fitted on training epochs

selection_rule: lowest validation balanced error; ties use grid order; no test data selection

calibration.physical_epsilon_rule: maximum true whitened probe-operator spectral norm over validation heads; test inclusion is descriptive only
calibration.source_probe_basis: spatial identity pI32, p=source_contrast_l2_am; simulator-only probes, not validated physical stimulation
calibration.norm_model: spatial epsilon=p||Ws Espace||op; separable target radius=epsilon*||a||/p*||Wt waveform||; Espace tensor I_time

protocol_changes.reason: Clarify spatial probe uncertainty and its known temporal factor; replace radial sensor jitter with tangential jitter projected to actual spherical scalp to preserve physical contact geometry. No targets, amplitudes, noise levels, sample sizes, or decoder settings changed.
